questions.title: Single Inheritance Pet Sounds
questions.description:
The pet clinic wants a tiny inheritance demo. Define a class Animal with a field name and a method eat() that prints: <name> eats food. Define a class Dog that extends Animal and adds a method bark() that prints: <name> says woof. In main, read the dog's name into a Dog object, then call eat() (inherited from Animal) and bark() (defined in Dog itself).

Input Format:
A single line with one word: the dog's name.

Output Format:
Line 1: <name> eats food
Line 2: <name> says woof

Constraints:
1 <= name length <= 50 (single word)

Tommy eats food
Tommy says woof

Sheru says woof
questions.output1:

Bruno says woof

Kitty says woof

questions.title: Multilevel Device Boot Chain
questions.description:
A gadget factory models a three-level chain: Device, then Laptop, then GamingLaptop. Define class Device with a field brand and a method powerOn() that prints: <brand> powering on. Define class Laptop that extends Device with a method boot() that prints: <brand> booting OS. Define class GamingLaptop that extends Laptop with a method boost() that prints: <brand> boosting GPU. In main, read the brand, create one GamingLaptop object, and call powerOn(), boot() and boost() on it - two of them are inherited through the multilevel chain.

Input Format:
A single line with one word: the brand.

Output Format:
Line 1: <brand> powering on
Line 2: <brand> booting OS
Line 3: <brand> boosting GPU

Constraints:
1 <= brand length <= 50 (single word)

questions.title: Sibling Shape Areas
questions.description:
One Shape parent, two different child shapes - hierarchical inheritance. Define a base class Shape with a field title. Define class Triangle that extends Shape with fields base and height and a method area() returning 0.5 * base * height. Define class Square that extends Shape with field side and a method area() returning side * side. In main, read the triangle base, triangle height and square side, set each object's inherited title (Triangle and Square), and print both areas with 2 decimals.

Input Format:
A single line with three numbers: triangleBase triangleHeight squareSide.

Output Format:
Line 1: Triangle area: <area with 2 decimals>
Line 2: Square area: <area with 2 decimals>

Constraints:
0 < base, height, side <= 1000

questions.title: Abstract Shape Concrete Circle
questions.description:
An abstract class defines what a shape can do; subclasses decide how. Define an abstract class Shape with a field radius, a concrete method describe() that prints: This is a shape, and an abstract method area(). Define class Circle that extends Shape and implements area() as Math.PI * radius * radius. In main, read the radius into a Circle object held in a Shape reference, call describe() and print the area with 2 decimals.

Input Format:
A single line with one number: the radius r.

Output Format:
Line 1: This is a shape
Line 2: Area: <area with 2 decimals>

Constraints:
0 < r <= 10000

questions.title: Printable Badge Interface
questions.description:
An interface is a contract: whoever implements it must provide the methods. Define an interface Printable with a method void print(). Define class Badge that implements Printable with a field label and a print() method that prints: Printed: <label>. In main, read the label, store it in a Badge object, hold it in a Printable reference and call print().

Input Format:
A single line with one word: the badge label.

Output Format:
Print one line: Printed: <label>

Constraints:
1 <= label length <= 50 (single word)

questions.title: Super Show Extended Profile
questions.description:
super.method() lets a subclass reuse the parent's behavior and then add its own. Define class Employee with a field name and a method show() that prints: Profile: <name>. Define class Developer that extends Employee and overrides show() to first call super.show() and then print: Skills: Java. In main, read the name into a Developer object and call show().

Input Format:
A single line with one word: the employee name.

Output Format:
Line 1: Profile: <name>
Line 2: Skills: Java

Constraints:
1 <= name length <= 50 (single word)

questions.title: Manager Bonus Payroll Screen
questions.description:
The payroll screen of a startup lists every manager twice: the base income inherited from the Employee class and the total after adding the manager's bonus. Define class Employee with fields name and salary and a method income() that returns salary. Define class Manager that extends Employee with an extra field bonus and a method total() that returns salary + bonus. In main, read name, salary and bonus, and print both amounts with 2 decimals.

Input Format:
A single line with three values: name salary bonus (name is one word).

Output Format:
Line 1: Income: <salary with 2 decimals>
Line 2: Total: <salary + bonus with 2 decimals>

Constraints:
0 < salary, bonus <= 1000000

questions.title: Rental Bike Inherited Specs
questions.description:
A rental shop lists each bike's specs; the shared fields come from the parent class. Define class Vehicle with fields brand (String) and wheels (int). Define class Bike that extends Vehicle with an extra field gears and a method specs() that prints Brand: <brand>, Wheels: <wheels> and Gears: <gears> on three lines. In main, read brand, wheels and gears into a Bike object and call specs().

Input Format:
A single line with three values: brand wheels gears (brand is one word).

Output Format:
Line 1: Brand: <brand>
Line 2: Wheels: <wheels>
Line 3: Gears: <gears>

Constraints:
1 <= brand length <= 30, 1 <= wheels <= 4, 1 <= gears <= 10

questions.title: Bank Account Type Chooser
questions.description:
A bank offers two account flavors built on one base class - hierarchical inheritance. Define class Account with fields holder and balance. Define class SavingsAccount that extends Account with field rate and method addInterest() that adds balance * rate / 100 to balance. Define class CurrentAccount that extends Account with field fee and method applyFee() that subtracts fee from balance. In main read type (1 = savings, 2 = current), then holder, balance and the matching parameter, apply the operation, and print the holder and final balance with 2 decimals.

Input Format:
A single line: type holder balance param where type is 1 (param = rate) or 2 (param = fee); holder is one word.

Output Format:
Line 1: Holder: <holder>
Line 2: Balance: <final balance with 2 decimals>

Constraints:
type is 1 or 2, 0 < balance <= 1000000, 0 <= rate, fee <= 100000
questions.inputconstrains: type is 1 or 2, 0 < balance <= 1000000, 0 <= rate, fee <= 100000

questions.title: Geometry Report Abstract
questions.description:
A geometry dashboard reports the area of whichever shape the user picks, using one abstract parent. Define an abstract class Shape with an abstract method area(). Define class CircleArea that extends Shape with field r and area() = Math.PI * r * r, and class RectArea that extends Shape with fields w and h and area() = w * h. In main read choice (1 = circle with radius, 2 = rectangle with width and height), build the matching object in a Shape reference and print its area with 2 decimals.

Input Format:
A single line: choice dims where choice 1 has one dimension (radius) and choice 2 has two (width height).

Output Format:
Print one line: Area: <area with 2 decimals>

Constraints:
choice is 1 or 2, 0 < dimensions <= 10000

questions.title: Three Level Build Log
questions.description:
An assembly line logs every build stage from the base class upward. Define class Unit with a constructor that prints: Frame welded. Define class Laptop that extends Unit with a constructor that prints: Board installed. Define class GamingRig that extends Laptop with a constructor that prints: GPU mounted. In main read n and create n GamingRig objects; constructor chaining prints the full three-line log for every rig, base constructor first.

Input Format:
A single line with one integer n.

Output Format:
For each rig, three lines in order: Frame welded, Board installed, GPU mounted.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 5

questions.title: Multifunction Default Clash
questions.description:
A multifunction office device inherits default methods from two interfaces - and both define info(). Java refuses to choose for you: the class must override the method itself. Define interface PrintModule with default void info() printing: Print module ready. Define interface ScanModule with default void info() printing: Scan module ready. Define class MultiFunction that implements both, has a field model, and overrides info() to call PrintModule.super.info(), then ScanModule.super.info(), then print: <model> all modules ready. In main, read the model word and call info().

Input Format:
A single line with one word: the model name.

Output Format:
Line 1: Print module ready
Line 2: Scan module ready
Line 3: <model> all modules ready

Constraints:
1 <= model length <= 50 (single word)

Print module ready
Scan module ready
OfficePro all modules ready

Print module ready
Scan module ready
HomeHub all modules ready

Print module ready
Scan module ready
PrintX all modules ready
questions.output2:
Print module ready
Scan module ready
ScanOne all modules ready
questions.output3:
Print module ready
Scan module ready
MegaDesk all modules ready

questions.title: Report Template Pipeline
questions.description:
A report engine uses the template method pattern: the abstract parent fixes the pipeline, subclasses fill in the steps. Define an abstract class Report with abstract methods header() and body() and a concrete method generate() that calls header(), then body(), then prints: Report complete. Define SalesReport that extends Report printing Sales header / Sales figures, and HrReport that extends Report printing HR header / HR records. In main read n and then n kind words (sales or hr); store each matching Report object in an array using a Report reference, then call generate() on all of them in order.

Input Format:
First line: n. Second line: n words separated by spaces, each sales or hr.

Output Format:
For each report, its header line, its body line, then Report complete.

questions.title: Gadget Type Census
questions.description:
A store census counts gadgets by type. The base class keeps the shared total; each subclass keeps its own static counter - hierarchical inheritance with a shared base. Define class Gadget with static int total = 0 and a constructor that increments total. Define Phone that extends Gadget with static int count = 0 and a constructor that increments count. Define Tablet that extends Gadget the same way. In main read n and then n kind words (phone or tablet); create a matching object for each word, then print Phones: <count>, Tablets: <count> and Total: <total>.

Input Format:
First line: n. Second line: n words separated by spaces, each phone or tablet.

Output Format:
Line 1: Phones: <number of phones>
Line 2: Tablets: <number of tablets>
Line 3: Total: <total gadgets>

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, each kind is phone or tablet
questions.input3: 6 phone tablet phone tablet phone tablet
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= n <= 1000, each kind is phone or tablet

questions.title: Media Deck Command Runner
questions.description:
A media deck takes its behavior from two interfaces at once - multiple inheritance via interfaces. Define interface Playable with void play() and default void stop() printing: Playback stopped. Define interface Recordable with void record() and default void stop() printing: Recording stopped. Define class MediaDeck implementing both: play() prints Playing track, record() prints Recording track, and stop() is overridden to print Deck stopped (resolving the default conflict). In main read n and then n commands (play, record or stop) and run each on one MediaDeck.

Input Format:
First line: n. Second line: n command words separated by spaces.

Output Format:
One line per command: Playing track, Recording track or Deck stopped.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100, each command is play, record or stop

questions.title: Onboarding Card Super Chain
questions.description:
HR's onboarding card prints the staff record first, then the engineer's stack - the subclass constructor delegates to the parent with super(...). Define class Staff with field name and a constructor Staff(String name) that stores it and prints: Staff onboarded: <name>. Define class Engineer that extends Staff with field stack and a constructor Engineer(String name, String stack) that calls super(name), stores stack and prints: Stack: <stack>. In main read name and stack and create one Engineer.

Input Format:
A single line with two words: name stack.

Output Format:
Line 1: Staff onboarded: <name>
Line 2: Stack: <stack>

Constraints:
1 <= name, stack length <= 30 (single words)

questions.title: Payroll Engine Payslips
questions.description:
A payroll engine processes mixed employee types from one abstract parent. Define an abstract class Employee with field name, a constructor to set it, and an abstract method monthlyPay(). Define Salaried that extends Employee (field salary) where monthlyPay() returns salary, and Hourly that extends Employee (fields hours, rate) where monthlyPay() returns hours * rate. Input gives n entries: type S with name and salary, or type H with name, hours and rate. Store every employee in an Employee array, then print one payslip line per employee and finally the total payroll.

Input Format:
First line: n. Then n entries in the same order: S name salary OR H name hours rate (names are single words, values are integers).

Output Format:
One line per employee: <name>: <monthly pay>. Final line: Total: <sum of all pays>.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= salary <= 1000000, 1 <= hours <= 300, 1 <= rate <= 5000
questions.sampleinput1: 3 S Asha 50000 H Raj 160 250 S Maya 60000
questions.input1: 4 S Amy 10000 H Bob 80 500 S Cal 20000 H Dee 50 400

questions.title: Shape Studio Interface Dispatch
questions.description:
A shape studio dispatches work through one interface: every shape reports its label, area and perimeter. Define interface Shape with double area(), double perimeter() and String label(). Define Circle that implements Shape (field r: area = Math.PI * r * r, perimeter = 2 * Math.PI * r, label Circle) and Square that implements Shape (field s: area = s * s, perimeter = 4 * s, label Square). Input gives n shapes (circle with radius, or square with side). Store them in a Shape array, print each shape's label and area, then the total perimeter of all shapes.

Input Format:
First line: n. Then n entries: circle radius OR square side (values may be decimals).

Output Format:
One line per shape: <Label> area: <area with 2 decimals>. Final line: Total perimeter: <sum with 2 decimals>.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 0 < radius, side <= 10000

questions.title: Org Chart Pay Rollup
questions.description:
An org chart rolls pay upward through a multilevel chain using super. Define class Executive with fields name and basePay, a constructor, and a method pay() returning basePay. Define Manager that extends Executive with field teamBonus, a constructor calling super(name, basePay), and pay() returning super.pay() + teamBonus. Define Director that extends Manager with field stockAward, a constructor calling super(name, basePay, teamBonus), and pay() returning super.pay() + stockAward. Input gives n entries: role (1 = Executive, 2 = Manager, 3 = Director) followed by name basePay teamBonus stockAward (unused values are 0). Store each in an Executive array and print every pay line, then the total.

Input Format:
First line: n. Then n entries: role name basePay teamBonus stockAward (names are single words, values are integers).

Output Format:
One line per entry: Name: <name> Pay: <pay>. Final line: Total: <sum of all pays>.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, role is 1, 2 or 3, 0 <= basePay, teamBonus, stockAward <= 1000000

questions.title: Drawable Studio Render Engine
questions.description:
A drawing engine combines both blueprints from today: an abstract base class for shared state and an interface for the render contract. Define interface Drawable with void draw() and double area(). Define abstract class Shape with field name, a constructor Shape(String name) and an abstract method area(). Define Circle that extends Shape implements Drawable (area = Math.PI * r * r; draw() prints: Render circle area <area with 2 decimals>) and Square that extends Shape implements Drawable (area = s * s; draw() prints: Render square area <area with 2 decimals>). Input gives n shapes (circle radius or square side). Store them in a Drawable array, call draw() on each, then print the total area.

Input Format:
First line: n. Then n entries: circle radius OR square side (values may be decimals).

Output Format:
One line per shape as produced by draw(). Final line: Total area: <sum with 2 decimals>.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 0 < radius, side <= 10000
